items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Now, Louie Coleman, boy, he's a nice drummer, but he's not in the jazz business like we all, see. No. He's a young drummer.

ctx.x: Hard to pick. Hard to pick.

One or two right there. Hard to pick it. Some of them, they all used to get there and fight against one another, you know. Yeah. Yeah, like you'd be playing a job there, two or three drummers come there, and you'd better be good. Because they all come to show you up, see. And you had to play like that, only keep them from showing you up. Well, it was a hard thing to tell. Yeah. Yeah. But they had some pretty good drummers there, which they have some there now. Now, Louie Coleman, boy, he's a nice drummer, but…
